desc: Parse input fast (sys.stdin.buffer.read + split); store houses with indices 0..N-1.
Build by_y / by_x sorted lists with per-line DSU successor arrays for O(α) skip of visited houses.
Simulate M moves with inclusive-interval queries; enumerate/remove via DSU; count distinct houses.
Cache per-line coordinate arrays at build time instead of rebuilding `coords` inside every sweep call.
Verify on samples and stress-test vs brute force (endpoint hits, shared vertices, repeated sweeps over same houses, off-path houses, large coordinates).
